text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, Chrono-chan! Aren't you doing 
anything special?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... a-actually, to celebrate for myself, 
I was planning on spending the whole day 
in my room having a race screening 
session...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's awesome! Birthday excitement at 
120 miles per hour! Mind if I watch too!?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
B-But, really, we're just going to be 
staring at video footage the whole time... 
so, um, I feel bad making you tag alongâ

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it, don't worry about 
it! I love watching races too, you know?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Stuff like "Top 200 Front-Runners"... Just 
notes I compiled for my own personal 
use...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good~♪ The way front-runners zoom 
away is so cool! If there are 200 of them, 
there must be tons of Mile race videos, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Even so, the other videos are like, 
'180 Minutes of Majestic Paddock Footage' 
or 'Special Feature: The Racecourse 
Staff'...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
That sounds great! Appealing to the fans 
in the paddock is super important, after 
all!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Watching the folks who always prepare such 
wonderful racetracks for us... I'm curious 
at 120 miles per hour!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Both of you... fufufu. Well then... let's 
definitely have fun together!
